summary: Saint Michael is honored as the prince of angels and the defender of the people of God. He is invoked as a guardian against evil and a champion of justice.
antiphon_text: Let us remember Saint Michael the Archangel as a faithful witness to the love and mercy of Christ.
prayer_text: Lord God, through the life of Saint Michael the Archangel, strengthen us to follow your path with courage and charity. Grant us the grace to bear faithful witness in our own time. Through Christ our Lord. Amen.
